Team — quick synthesis after yesterday's panel for Kavya Kaur (SWE II / IC3-4). I attached the consolidated scorecards (Kaur_scorecards.pdf). Two asks: (1) confirm final locked score/rank by EOD Monday PT, and (2) flag any disqualifying concerns or strong hire signals so recruiting can act quickly.

Quick read: overall strong system design and backend fundamentals, soft spot on scaleable telemetry design (disagreement between reviewers). Major variance: Laura scored 7/10 on system design; Rishi and Jonas leaned 9/10. Marissa flagged communication/context switching as a potential growth area.

Proposed next steps:
- Everyone: add a single-line justification for your score in the attached PDF or reply to this thread by Monday 18:00 PT.
- If still split >2 points after justifications, we'll run a 15-min tiebreak call Tuesday 10:00 PT (calendar link below) with Rishi as the designated arbitrator.
- Talent ops (cc): please hold on outreach until we lock. If we go forward, target offer window: within 48 hours of lock.

Attachments: Kaur_scorecards.pdf (consolidated scores + comments)

Thanks — David

Appreciate the thread, David. I added a 1-paragraph justification in the PDF (scored 7/10). My concern is less about Kavya's proximate answer and more about the depth of tradeoff framing — in the interview she focused on correctness and lost an explicit cost/latency tradeoff conversation. If we think mentorship + a short onboarding spike on observability is feasible, that's fine, but I wanted to call that out as a material gap for an IC3->IC4 stretch.
